Total value of Civil Engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years year-wise

List of works for which tenders already submitted

Banker Details

Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value Min Rs.500/- or & Max Rs.7500/- or soon after contract has been issued to bidder

As per Karnataka state Government order No. LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007 a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards labour welfare fund and contractors should follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act.

Tenderer shall obtain the Work Done Certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer District Level Officer and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the bid
Financial year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty First day of March of succeeding year both days inclusive
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all tenders without assigning any reasons.
Royalty Charges will be Deducted in every bill of contract as per rules
The bidder is required to maintain the road executed and completed projects during the defect liability period of 1 years (365 days) from the date of completion of the Work
Department Registration Details
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

All safety precautions warning signs night illumination reflectors deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. The contractor should indemnify the client to that extent

The Item Rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on constructive materials & other taxes as per the rates prevailing Government Orders at the time of execution and including cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and unloading with all leads and lifts, labour, hire charges of machinery & equipment etc., complete and all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of work
Tenderer who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value
All Materials required for this work shall be procured by the bidder himself and should got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on the work.
To qualify for award of this contract each bidder should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-2 KPWD and further orders thereon
period for completion of work is 06 Months (including monsoon)
Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit for an amount 5% of the Contract price
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing eprocurement portal
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2025-26 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section
The Tenderer should be a PWD Registered class III & Above contractor
The Earnest Money Deposit Rs. 68000.00 By epayment infavour of Executive Engineer PWD Division Karwar
Only relevant document needs to be uploaded. Un-necessary documents or any kind of fake documents will lead to rejection of tender
Terms and conditions as per KW-2
Any deviation / error / mistake found in units of items they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24 and the rates shall be quoted accordingly
The Estimate rates are exclusive of 18% GST
GST will ne paid as per the present rates at 18%, if GST revises (Increases or Decreases) same shall be paid accordingly as per the Govt Circular No. FD 417 EXP-12/2024 Dtd:09.08.2024
